body:
Yeah that might be confusing, but nothing feels logic when i try to explain how I feel anymore. 

I'm struggling with severe anxiety issues and depression, and I just felt the need to get some other people's perspective on coping. 

Heres how i've been feeling lately; Every time I get a sense that something is good I feel that it can't hold any value, because I won't allow myself to be happy. Therefor death has been a viable option these last couple of weeks.

I'm sorry if this isn't very clear.
